Class RmiServer

java.lang.Object
java.rmi.server.RemoteObject
java.rmi.server.RemoteServer
java.rmi.server.UnicastRemoteObject
it.polimi.ingsw.am56.network.rmi.server.RmiServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerRmi, Serializable, Remote
public class RmiServer extends UnicastRemoteObject implements VirtualServerRmi
RMI side of the server: an exported VirtualServerRmi that clients look up in the registry to join the game, send requests and ping the server. It shares the same GameModel, GameController and EndGameService as the socket server, so RMI and socket clients play in one game.

For each joining client it creates an RmiClientHandler (the server-side connection) and a PlayerVirtualView registered as a model observer, so the client receives updates. Requests are executed on a cached thread pool; any InvalidActionException is reported back to the originating client.

    • start

      public void start()
      Creates the RMI registry on the configured port and binds this server under the name "MesosServer". Startup errors are logged rather than thrown.

    • addClient

      public void addClient(VirtualViewRmi clientStub) throws RemoteException
      Registers a new RMI client: starts a RmiClientHandler for it and attaches a PlayerVirtualView as a model observer so the client receives game updates. The connection is refused (the call throws) once the game is in progress and no reconnection window is open — see GameController.acceptsNewConnections() — so outsiders cannot join a game that has already started.
      Specified by:
      addClient in interface VirtualServerRmi
      Parameters:
      clientStub - the joining client's remote view stub
      Throws:
      RemoteException - if the remote call fails, or if the game is in progress and no new connections are being accepted
